newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo naphtha notionally higher in slim talks.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo naphtha notionally higher in slim talks.

text.p: Naphtha prices were slightly higher in very quiet afternoon trade with most naphtha traders and brokers attending an annual open-spec naphtha meeting that started on Monday in Tokyo, traders said.
"Today's prices are purely notional as most regional naphtha dealers are away from their offices for the conference," one naphtha broker said.
Open-spec naphtha for second-half August was nominally assessed at $197.00/199.00 per tonne, compared with late Friday's $196.50/198.00.
Over the weekend, little progress was made in naphtha term talks between Abu Dhabi and its east Asian clients for one-year supply contracts starting in July, traders said.
A one-dollar gap remains between Abu Dhabi National Oil Co's (ADNOC) offer price at $21.00 per tonne over the ADNOC formula and potential buyers' latest bid at around $20.00.
